result.instructions: Tools for Coevera, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which opportunities close this month, and which of them are still open?"; "Find the contacts of the account Northwind and show their e-mail addresses."; "Create a lead for Jan Novak from the website form and assign it to me.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Coevera data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run coevera_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run coevera_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run coevera_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. coevera_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: coevera_list_accounts
tools.description: List accounts (companies) in the Coevera space, optionally by name. Returns data and page_info; pass page_info.end_cursor as after for the next page.

after.description: Cursor: page_info.end_cursor of the previous page

order.description: Sort field; a leading - sorts descending (for example -modified)

fields.description: Fields to return (default: id, name, email1, city, country, modified)

tools.name: coevera_get_account
tools.description: Get one account by id, with all its fields.

id.description: Record id (UUID), as returned by a list

tools.name: coevera_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts (people) in the Coevera space, by last name or exact e-mail. Returns data and page_info.

after.description: Cursor: page_info.end_cursor of the previous page

order.description: Sort field; a leading - sorts descending (for example -modified)

fields.description: Fields to return (default: id, first_name, last_name, email1, phone1, modified)

tools.name: coevera_get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact by id, with all its fields.

id.description: Record id (UUID), as returned by a list

tools.name: coevera_list_leads
tools.description: List leads in the Coevera space, by name, pipeline step or owner. Returns data and page_info.

step_id.description: Only leads in this lead process step (id from a list)

owner_id.description: Only leads owned by this user (id from coevera_list_clients)

after.description: Cursor: page_info.end_cursor of the previous page

order.description: Sort field; a leading - sorts descending (for example -modified)

fields.description: Fields to return (default: id, name, step_id, owner_id, modified)

tools.name: coevera_get_lead
tools.description: Get one lead by id, with all its fields.

id.description: Record id (UUID), as returned by a list

tools.name: coevera_list_opportunities
tools.description: List opportunities (deals) in the Coevera space, by name, owner and closing date range. Returns data and page_info.

owner_id.description: Only opportunities owned by this user (id from coevera_list_clients)

closing_from.description: Closing date on or after (use one closing bound per call), as YYYY-MM-DD

closing_to.description: Closing date on or before (use one closing bound per call), as YYYY-MM-DD

after.description: Cursor: page_info.end_cursor of the previous page

order.description: Sort field; a leading - sorts descending (for example -modified)

fields.description: Fields to return (default: id, name, closing_date, step_id, owner_id, modified)

tools.name: coevera_get_opportunity
tools.description: Get one opportunity by id, with all its fields.

id.description: Record id (UUID), as returned by a list

tools.name: coevera_list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks in the Coevera space, by status, owner or due date. Status: 1 NotStarted, 2 InProgress, 3 Waiting, 4 Completed, 5 Deferred.

status.description: Only tasks with this status (1 to 5)

owner_id.description: Only tasks of this owner (id from coevera_list_clients)

due_before.description: Due date on or before, as YYYY-MM-DD

after.description: Cursor: page_info.end_cursor of the previous page

order.description: Sort field; a leading - sorts descending (for example -modified)

fields.description: Fields to return (default: id, subject, status, priority, due_date, owner_id, modified)

tools.name: coevera_list_pipelines
tools.description: List the sales pipelines of the Coevera space, optionally by name. Use their ids with coevera_list_steps.

after.description: Cursor: page_info.end_cursor of the previous page

fields.description: Fields to return (default: id, name, modified)

tools.name: coevera_list_steps
tools.description: List the steps of a pipeline, in their sort order. Step ids are used by opportunities and leads.

after.description: Cursor: page_info.end_cursor of the previous page

fields.description: Fields to return (default: id, name, pipeline_id, percent, sort_order)

tools.name: coevera_list_clients
tools.description: List the users (clients) of the Coevera space, optionally by name. Their ids are the owner_id of records and tasks.

after.description: Cursor: page_info.end_cursor of the previous page

fields.description: Fields to return (default: id, name, email, first_name, last_name, modified)

tools.name: coevera_create_lead
tools.description: Create a lead. Needs a name and an owner_id (a user id from coevera_list_clients) or a unit_id. Creates one record; nothing else changes.

unit_id.description: Sales unit id, instead of owner_id

step_id.description: Lead process step id (from a list)

quick_account_name.description: Company name typed on the lead

quick_contact_name.description: Person name typed on the lead

tools.name: coevera_update_lead
tools.description: Change a lead: its name, description, step or owner. Send only the fields to change. Pass the revision from get_lead when the lead may have changed.

id.description: Record id (UUID), as returned by a list

revision.description: Revision read from the lead; a conflict is refused

tools.name: coevera_create_task
tools.description: Create a task. Needs a subject; the owner, due date, priority and status are optional. Creates one record.

tools.name: coevera_update_task
tools.description: Change a task: its subject, status, due date, priority, owner or description. Send only the fields to change.

id.description: Record id (UUID), as returned by a list

revision.description: Revision read from the task; a conflict is refused

tools.name: coevera_create_note
tools.description: Add a note to an account, a contact or a lead/opportunity. Needs the note text and the author's owner_id. Creates one record.

note.description: Note text (plain text or sanitized HTML)

lead_oppty_id.description: Lead or opportunity the note belongs to
